story:
Ethan went to the park carrying a big, crinkled map he had drawn himself. [emotion:QT/happy] The map showed a secret superhero trail with five hidden checkpoints, and Ethan was buzzing with excitement like a rocket before takeoff.

[emotion:QT/sad] But when Ethan reached the tall, twisted oak tree, he saw that the wooden sign pointing to checkpoint three was completely gone.

[emotion:QT/afraid] Ethan froze. He had worked so hard on this trail, and now it was broken.

A girl named Maya was sitting nearby, sketching vehicles in a small notebook. [gesture:hi] [emotion:QT/happy] "Hey! I am really good at finding things," she said cheerfully. "Can I help you look?[emotion:QT/shy] [gesture:nodding-yes] "

Ethan nodded slowly, although he felt a little nervous about asking. While Maya searched behind the bushes, Ethan described exactly where the sign had been standing before it fell.

[emotion:QT/happy] Together, they found the sign beneath a pile of crunchy leaves. [gesture:clapping] [emotion:QT/happy] "We did it!" Maya cheered, and Ethan laughed so loudly that two squirrels ran away.

[emotion:QT/happy] Ethan felt proud and grateful, because he had asked for help and gained a friend.

paragraphs: Ethan went to the park carrying a big, crinkled map he had drawn himself. The map showed a secret superhero trail with five hidden checkpoints, and Ethan was buzzing with excitement like a rocket before takeoff.
But when Ethan reached the tall, twisted oak tree, he saw that the wooden sign pointing to checkpoint three was completely gone.
Ethan froze. He had worked so hard on this trail, and now it was broken.
A girl named Maya was sitting nearby, sketching vehicles in a small notebook. "Hey! I am really good at finding things," she said cheerfully. "Can I help you look?"
Ethan nodded slowly, although he felt a little nervous about asking. While Maya searched behind the bushes, Ethan described exactly where the sign had been standing before it fell.
Together, they found the sign beneath a pile of crunchy leaves. "We did it!" Maya cheered, and Ethan laughed so loudly that two squirrels ran away.
Ethan felt proud and grateful, because he had asked for help and gained a friend.
scenes: Ethan at the park, holding his large, crinkled map, looking excited and buzzing with anticipation.
Ethan standing by a tall, twisted oak tree, looking dismayed at the empty spot where a wooden sign should be.
A girl named Maya sitting nearby, sketching in a notebook, looking up to speak cheerfully to Ethan.
Maya actively searching behind bushes while Ethan stands nearby, gesturing and describing the sign's location.
Ethan and Maya kneeling together, pointing at the sign they found beneath a pile of leaves, both cheering happily.
Ethan and Maya standing together, smiling at each other, reflecting their new friendship and Ethan's pride.

questions.question: What is the main message of this story about Ethan and his superhero trail?
questions.correct_answer: It is good to ask for help and make new friends.
wrong_answers: Ethan found a lost map in the park.
Maya was drawing a new game vehicle.

questions.question: What was Ethan carrying when he went to the park to find his hidden checkpoints?
questions.correct_answer: A big, crinkled map he had drawn himself.

questions.question: What was Maya doing while Ethan was looking for the missing sign near the twisted oak tree?
questions.correct_answer: She was sketching game vehicles in a notebook.
wrong_answers: She was reading a book about superheroes.
She was playing a video game on her phone.

questions.question: Why do you think Ethan felt a little nervous about asking Maya for help, although she offered cheerfully?
questions.correct_answer: He did not know her well yet.
wrong_answers: He was afraid of the squirrels.
He wanted to find it all by himself.

questions.question: What do you think would have happened if Ethan had not asked Maya for help to find the checkpoint sign?
questions.correct_answer: He might not have found the sign and felt sad.
wrong_answers: He would have drawn a new map.
Maya would have left the park right away.

takeaways: Asking for help when something is hard makes you smarter and stronger.
Working together with a friend helps you solve problems faster.
Being kind to someone new is how great friendships start.
